custom_logic_notes: MQL5 Wizard-generated EA using CExpert, CSignalMACD_ParabolicSAR (combines MACD crossover with Parabolic SAR trend confirmation for dual-indicator signal), CTrailingFixed (fixed-pip trailing stop), and CMoneyFixedLot (fixed lot sizing). Long entry requires MACD main above signal AND SAR below close (bullish trend confirmation). Short entry requires MACD main below signal AND SAR above close (bearish trend confirmation). Signal reversal also triggers position close (opposite signal closes existing position). The digit adjustment logic doubles pip values by 10 when broker uses 5-digit/3-digit pricing.
python_conversion_notes: Standard MQL5 Wizard EA with clean class-based architecture. MACD indicator is universally available in Python (ta-lib, pandas-ta). Parabolic SAR is also standard. Entry logic is a simple AND combination of MACD crossover + SAR trend direction. Digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers must be handled in SL/TP/Trailing calculations. CExpert framework's trailing stop logic needs to be reimplemented: check if profit exceeds TrailingStop pips, then modify SL to current_price - TrailingStop (for long) or current_price + TrailingStop (for short). Position gate is 'no_position' - only one position at a time, with signal reversal closing opposite before entering new.
